answer_1.quote: Experiments on Live-CodeBench and HumanEval demonstrate that XCoder... achieves superior performance ... while using fewer training samples.
answer_1.outputs: Generated code solutions evaluated by unit tests (Pass@1, Base-Pass@1, Plus-Pass@1, Easy-Pass@1).

answer_2.quote: We report both Base-Pass@1 and Plus-Pass@1 results, where Plus-Pass@1 uses more test cases compared to Base-Pass@1 during evaluation. On LiveCodeBench, we report Pass@1 and Easy-Pass@1 results.

answer_3.quote: We also consider another method where using LLMs to output the correctness of the code directly. We choose GPT-4-0409 to do that.
